  "version": 1,
  "kind": "skill",
  "unit": "folder",
  "targets": "plugins/*/skills/*",
  "scope": [".claude/skills/*", ".cursor/skills/*", ".opencode/skills/*", ".kilo/skills/*", ".github/skills/*", ".agents/skills/*"],
  "marker": "SKILL.md",
  "rules": {
    "SKILL-01": { "op": "max", "measure": "chars", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "description", "max": 150,
      "why": "every description loads in every session", "fix": "cut the description to 150 characters, it has {actual}" },
    "SKILL-02": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "description", "regex": ":",
      "why": "a colon breaks unquoted YAML on some hosts", "fix": "remove the colon from the description" },
    "SKILL-03": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "description", "regex": "\\s[-–—]\\s",
      "why": "a dash splits the trigger into two claims", "fix": "remove the dash separator from the description" },
    "SKILL-04": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "description", "regex": "[.!?]\\s+\\S",
      "why": "the model matches one trigger sentence", "fix": "make the description one sentence" },
    "SKILL-05": { "op": "sections", "in": "SKILL.md", "allowed": ["Transversal rules"],
      "why": "the router loads on every call; detail belongs in actions", "fix": "keep only the diagram and the transversal rules after the title" },
    "SKILL-06": { "op": "custom", "in": "SKILL.md", "check": "router-diagram",
      "why": "the diagram is the only route to an action" },
    "SKILL-07": { "op": "custom", "in": "SKILL.md", "check": "router-edges",
      "why": "an edge the model cannot follow is a dead route", "fix": "link the target action from the source step" },
    "SKILL-08": { "op": "pattern", "in": "actions/*.md", "line": 1, "regex": "^# \\d\\d - \\S",
      "why": "the number orders actions across hosts", "fix": "start with `# <NN> - <Title>`" },
    "SKILL-09": { "op": "sections", "in": "actions/*.md", "allowed": ["Input", "Process", "Output", "Rules"], "order": true,
      "why": "one shape lets the model find the steps", "fix": "use only and in order Input, Process, Output, Rules" },
    "SKILL-10": { "op": "custom", "in": "actions/*.md", "check": "read-next",
      "why": "a chained action that does not link the next stops the flow", "fix": "end with a step that reads the next action, as a link" },
    "SKILL-11": { "op": "oneSentence", "in": ["SKILL.md", "actions/*.md"], "sections": ["Process", "Rules", "Transversal rules"], "skipIndentedIn": ["Rules", "Transversal rules"],
      "why": "one instruction per item is followed, two are merged", "fix": "keep one sentence per item, or put exact text in backticks; in a step, cases go as dash sub-items" },
    "SKILL-12": { "op": "flatList", "in": ["SKILL.md", "actions/*.md"], "sections": ["Rules", "Transversal rules"],
      "why": "a nested rule hides its condition", "fix": "write the rule on one line, its case inside the sentence" },
    "SKILL-13": { "op": "max", "measure": "lines", "in": "{actions,references}/**/*.md", "max": 100,
      "why": "a long action dilutes the step being run", "fix": "split the file, it has {actual} lines" },
    "SKILL-14": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "**/*.md", "notIn": "assets/**", "scope": "nofence", "regex": "<!--[\\s\\S]*?--!?>",
      "why": "hosts strip or show comments inconsistently", "fix": "state it in the prose, or move it to an asset" },
    "SKILL-15": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "**/*.md", "notIn": "assets/**", "regex": "\\{\\{[^{}\\n]*\\}\\}",
      "why": "an unfilled slot is read as an instruction", "fix": "fill the template slot, or move it to an asset" },
    "SKILL-16": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "**/*.md", "regex": "\\*\\*",
      "why": "bold competes with the instruction order", "fix": "write the sentence without bold" },
    "SKILL-17": { "op": "links", "in": "**/*.md", "notIn": "assets/**",
      "why": "a dead link is a step the model cannot take", "fix": "fix the link, {target} does not exist" },
    "SKILL-18": { "op": "equals", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "name", "to": "folder",
      "why": "hosts that validate skills require the name to be the folder's", "fix": "name the skill {expected}, as its folder" },
    "SKILL-20": { "op": "pattern", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "description", "regex": "\\S",

      "why": "a plugin works without its siblings installed" }
  },
  "retired": []
}

## project/.kilo/plugin/aidd-context-hooks.js
// Generated by aidd: aidd-context/hooks/hooks.json.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const HOOKS_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL("../hooks/aidd-context/", import.meta.url));
const SESSION_START = [{"script":"memory.cjs","args":["load"]},{"script":"artifacts.cjs","args":["start"]}];
const STOP = [{"script":"memory.cjs","args":["sync"]}];
const POST_TOOL_USE = [{"script":"artifacts.cjs","args":["mark"],"matcher":"Write|Edit|Bash|Shell|bash|PowerShell|apply_patch"}];

function runHook(script, args, payload, directory) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
    cwd: directory,
    stdio: ["pipe", "ignore", "ignore"],
    timeout: 5000,
  });
  let reported = false;
  const report = (error) => {
    if (reported) return;
    reported = true;
    reportHookFailure(script, error);
  };
  child.on("error", report);
  child.on("close", (code, signal) => {
    if (code !== 0 || signal !== null) {
      report("exited with code " + String(code) + (signal === null ? "" : " (" + signal + ")"));
    }
  });
  child.stdin.on("error", report);
  child.stdin.end(body);
}

// Exit 2 puts the answer on stderr; exit 0 puts it in additionalContext on stdout.
function answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr) {
  if (code === 2) return stderr.trim();
  if (code !== 0) return "";
  try {
    const output = JSON.parse(stdout);
    return String(output?.hookSpecificOutput?.additionalContext ?? output?.additionalContext ?? "").trim();
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

/** A Stop script's {"decision":"block","reason"} on stdout: the reason to keep working on. */
function stopReasonOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let stdout = "";
    const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
      cwd: directory,
      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "ignore"],
      timeout: 5000,
    });
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => { stdout += chunk; });
    child.on("error", () => resolve(""));
    child.on("close", (code) => {
      if (code !== 0) return resolve("");
      try {
        const output = JSON.parse(stdout);
        resolve(output?.decision === "block" ? String(output.reason ?? "").trim() : "");
      } catch {
        resolve("");
      }
    });
    child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
    child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
  });
}

function answerOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let stdout = "";
    let stderr = "";
    const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
      cwd: directory,
      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
      timeout: 5000,
    });
    const fail = (error) => {
      reportHookFailure(script, error);
      resolve("");
    };
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => { stdout += chunk; });
    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => { stderr += chunk; });
    child.on("error", fail);
    child.on("close", (code, signal) => {
      if ((code !== 0 && code !== 2) || signal !== null) {
        fail("exited with code " + String(code) + (signal === null ? "" : " (" + signal + ")"));
        return;
      }
      resolve(answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr));
    });
    child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
    child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
  });
}

function reportHookFailure(script, error) {
  console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook " + script + " failed: " + String(error));
}

function sessionStartCallsFor(event, directory) {
  if (event?.type !== "session.created") return [];
  return SESSION_START.map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: { hook_event_name: "SessionStart", session_id: event.properties?.sessionID ?? null, cwd: event.properties?.info?.directory ?? directory },
  }));
}

const AiddContextKiloHooks = async ({ directory, client }) => {
  const sessions = new Map();
  return {
  event: async ({ event }) => {
    try {
      const properties = event?.properties;
      const id = properties?.sessionID;
      if (typeof id !== "string") return;
      if (event?.type === "session.deleted") { sessions.delete(id); return; }
      if (!sessions.has(id)) sessions.set(id, { started: false, idle: false, continued: false, directory });
      const session = sessions.get(id);
      let calls = [];
      if (event?.type === "session.created" && !session.started) {
        session.started = true;
        session.directory = properties?.info?.directory ?? directory;
        calls = sessionStartCallsFor(event, session.directory);
      } else if (event?.type === "session.status" && properties?.status?.type === "busy") {
        session.idle = false;
      } else if (event?.type === "session.idle" && !session.idle) {
        session.idle = true;
        for (const hook of STOP) {
          const payload = { hook_event_name: "Stop", session_id: id, cwd: session.directory, stop_hook_active: session.continued };
          const reason = await stopReasonOf(hook.script, hook.args, payload, session.directory);
          session.continued = reason !== "";
          // Not awaited: the prompt is the session's next turn, and this handler must not hold it.
          if (reason) {
            client.session
              .promptAsync({ path: { id }, body: { parts: [{ type: "text", text: reason }] } })
              .catch(() => {});
          }
        }
      }
      for (const call of calls) {
        runHook(call.script, call.args, call.payload, call.payload.cwd);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  "tool.execute.after": async (call, output) => {
    try {
      const tool = String(call?.tool ?? "");
      const cwd = sessions.get(call?.sessionID)?.directory ?? directory;
      // Kilo names the written file filePath; the scripts read Claude Code's file_path.
      const args = call?.args;
      const toolInput = typeof args?.filePath === "string" ? { ...args, file_path: args.filePath } : args;
      for (const hook of POST_TOOL_USE.filter(hook => !hook.matcher || hook.matcher.split("|").some(name => name.toLowerCase() === tool.toLowerCase()))) {
        const answer = await answerOf(hook.script, hook.args, { hook_event_name: "PostToolUse", session_id: call?.sessionID ?? null, cwd, tool_name: tool, tool_input: toolInput }, cwd);
        if (answer) output.output = `${output.output ?? ""}\n\n${answer}`;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  };
};

AiddContextKiloHooks.sessionStartCallsFor = sessionStartCallsFor;

export default { id: "aidd-context-hooks", server: AiddContextKiloHooks };


## project/.kilo/plugin/aidd-telemetry-hooks.js
// Generated by aidd: aidd-telemetry/hooks/hooks.json.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const HOOKS_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL("../hooks/aidd-telemetry/", import.meta.url));
const SESSION_START = [{"script":"session-start.cjs","args":[]},{"script":"catch-up.cjs","args":[]}];
const STOP = [];
const POST_TOOL_USE = [];

function runHook(script, args, payload, directory) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
    cwd: directory,
    stdio: ["pipe", "ignore", "ignore"],
    timeout: 5000,
  });
  let reported = false;
  const report = (error) => {
    if (reported) return;
    reported = true;
    reportHookFailure(script, error);
  };
  child.on("error", report);
  child.on("close", (code, signal) => {
    if (code !== 0 || signal !== null) {
      report("exited with code " + String(code) + (signal === null ? "" : " (" + signal + ")"));
    }
  });
  child.stdin.on("error", report);
  child.stdin.end(body);
}

// Exit 2 puts the answer on stderr; exit 0 puts it in additionalContext on stdout.
function answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr) {
  if (code === 2) return stderr.trim();
  if (code !== 0) return "";
  try {
    const output = JSON.parse(stdout);
    return String(output?.hookSpecificOutput?.additionalContext ?? output?.additionalContext ?? "").trim();
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

/** A Stop script's {"decision":"block","reason"} on stdout: the reason to keep working on. */
function stopReasonOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let stdout = "";
    const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
      cwd: directory,
      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "ignore"],
      timeout: 5000,
    });
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => { stdout += chunk; });
    child.on("error", () => resolve(""));
    child.on("close", (code) => {
      if (code !== 0) return resolve("");
      try {
        const output = JSON.parse(stdout);
        resolve(output?.decision === "block" ? String(output.reason ?? "").trim() : "");
      } catch {
        resolve("");
      }
    });
    child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
    child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
  });
}

function answerOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let stdout = "";
    let stderr = "";
    const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
      cwd: directory,
      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
      timeout: 5000,
    });
    const fail = (error) => {
      reportHookFailure(script, error);
      resolve("");
    };
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => { stdout += chunk; });
    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => { stderr += chunk; });
    child.on("error", fail);
    child.on("close", (code, signal) => {
      if ((code !== 0 && code !== 2) || signal !== null) {
        fail("exited with code " + String(code) + (signal === null ? "" : " (" + signal + ")"));
        return;
      }
      resolve(answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr));
    });
    child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
    child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
  });
}

function reportHookFailure(script, error) {
  console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook " + script + " failed: " + String(error));
}

function sessionStartCallsFor(event, directory) {
  if (event?.type !== "session.created") return [];
  return SESSION_START.map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: { hook_event_name: "SessionStart", session_id: event.properties?.sessionID ?? null, cwd: event.properties?.info?.directory ?? directory },
  }));
}

const AiddTelemetryKiloHooks = async ({ directory, client }) => {
  const sessions = new Map();
  return {
  event: async ({ event }) => {
    try {
      const properties = event?.properties;
      const id = properties?.sessionID;
      if (typeof id !== "string") return;
      if (event?.type === "session.deleted") { sessions.delete(id); return; }
      if (!sessions.has(id)) sessions.set(id, { started: false, idle: false, continued: false, directory });
      const session = sessions.get(id);
      let calls = [];
      if (event?.type === "session.created" && !session.started) {
        session.started = true;
        session.directory = properties?.info?.directory ?? directory;
        calls = sessionStartCallsFor(event, session.directory);
      } else if (event?.type === "session.status" && properties?.status?.type === "busy") {
        session.idle = false;
      } else if (event?.type === "session.idle" && !session.idle) {
        session.idle = true;
        for (const hook of STOP) {
          const payload = { hook_event_name: "Stop", session_id: id, cwd: session.directory, stop_hook_active: session.continued };
          const reason = await stopReasonOf(hook.script, hook.args, payload, session.directory);
          session.continued = reason !== "";
          // Not awaited: the prompt is the session's next turn, and this handler must not hold it.
          if (reason) {
            client.session
              .promptAsync({ path: { id }, body: { parts: [{ type: "text", text: reason }] } })
              .catch(() => {});
          }
        }
      }
      for (const call of calls) {
        runHook(call.script, call.args, call.payload, call.payload.cwd);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  "tool.execute.after": async (call, output) => {
    try {
      const tool = String(call?.tool ?? "");
      const cwd = sessions.get(call?.sessionID)?.directory ?? directory;
      // Kilo names the written file filePath; the scripts read Claude Code's file_path.
      const args = call?.args;
      const toolInput = typeof args?.filePath === "string" ? { ...args, file_path: args.filePath } : args;
      for (const hook of POST_TOOL_USE.filter(hook => !hook.matcher || hook.matcher.split("|").some(name => name.toLowerCase() === tool.toLowerCase()))) {
        const answer = await answerOf(hook.script, hook.args, { hook_event_name: "PostToolUse", session_id: call?.sessionID ?? null, cwd, tool_name: tool, tool_input: toolInput }, cwd);
        if (answer) output.output = `${output.output ?? ""}\n\n${answer}`;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  };
};

AiddTelemetryKiloHooks.sessionStartCallsFor = sessionStartCallsFor;

export default { id: "aidd-telemetry-hooks", server: AiddTelemetryKiloHooks };
